create_uvdoc_image_processor: create a UVDocImageProcessor instance for preprocessing document images with resize and normalization
run_preprocess_images: run the _preprocess method to group, rescale, normalize, resize, and reorder batch document images into pixel values
run_post_process_document_rectification: run post_process_document_rectification to apply predicted Bezier mesh coordinates and rectify warped document images
group_images_by_shape: group document images by their spatial dimensions for efficient batch processing
reorder_images: reorder processed image batches back to their original input order after grouping by shape
